This relay is the one live retrieval instrument and NOTHING IS STRANDED TODAY FOR WANT OF FETCH. THE FETCH SERVICE'S FAILURE MODE IS DNS-LEVEL (ENOTFOUND) AND NOT THE 403 THE 2026-08-02/08-03 CONTROLLED TEST RECORDED. I report the difference as a diagnostic detail about the layer, and I draw NO capability conclusion from it: dead by 403 and dead by ENOTFOUND are the same dead, and the 11-05 and 11-06 batches recorded the same ENOTFOUND, so this is not new today either. MY OWN DELIVERY CHECKED BEFORE I WRITE ABOUT ANYONE ELSE'S (5.8(3)), AND IT IS ALREADY DEGRADED: daily-update run 850 fired 2026-11-08T00:19:26Z, nineteen minutes into today, took the --escalate path, and emailed the operator 'ISDS Daily Council Meeting -- 2026-11-08 -- ALERT: no record by end of day' with sent: True. THIS IS NOT A NEW MECHANISM AND I DO NOT PRESENT IT AS ONE: 1106-S9 established the drift and said in terms that an escalation run 'crossed midnight and became an escalation for the wrong date'. What 2026-11-07 adds is the FIRST REALIZED INSTANCE in which the thing the alarm exists to catch -- a sitting that did not happen -- actually occurred while the alarm was pointed at the wrong day.
